Compute all metrics on a fitted-result list

Source: R/metrics.R
score_all.Rd

Convenience wrapper that runs the per-metric helpers on a result list produced by [adaptive_fft()] / [run_beam_fft()] / any other runner returning the standard contract `(pred, score?, n_cues_per_row?, train_time)`.

Usage

score_all(result)

Arguments

result

List with elements `y_test`, `pred`, optional `score`, optional `n_cues_per_row`, and optional `train_time`.

Value

Named list with `acc`, `bacc`, `f1`, `auc`, `frugality`, `train_time`, `n_test`, `n_pos_test`.

Examples

set.seed(1)
y <- rbinom(50, 1, 0.4)
p <- ifelse(runif(50) < 0.8, y, 1L - y)
score_all(list(y_test = y, pred = p, n_cues_per_row = sample(1:4, 50, TRUE),
               train_time = 0.01))
#> $acc
#> [1] 0.82
#> 
#> $bacc
#> [1] 0.8268921
#> 
#> $f1
#> [1] 0.8235294
#> 
#> $auc
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $frugality
#> [1] 2.58
#> 
#> $train_time
#> [1] 0.01
#> 
#> $n_test
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $n_pos_test
#> [1] 23
#>
